question: Program studi apa saja yang tersedia di SEMUA jalur pendaftaran SPMB Poltekkes Kemenkes Yogyakarta (Jalur Mandiri, SPMB Bersama, SPMB Mandiri Profesi, SPMB Mandiri Reguler SMA, dan SPMB Prestasi)?
expected_answer: Sarjana Terapan Keperawatan adalah satu-satunya program studi yang tersedia di seluruh 5 jalur pendaftaran.
notes: Multi-hop aggregation across 5 jalur relations (TERSEDIA_PADA), each detailed in a separate source document. Verified via direct read-only Cypher query against live Neo4j on 2026-07-25.

question: Program studi D-III Keperawatan bisa didaftar melalui jalur pendaftaran apa saja?
expected_answer: D-III Keperawatan tersedia melalui SPMB Bersama, SPMB Mandiri Reguler SMA, dan SPMB Prestasi. D-III Keperawatan TIDAK tersedia melalui Jalur Mandiri (RPL) maupun SPMB Mandiri Profesi.
notes: Requires combining program-availability facts scattered across 3 separate jalur documents; also implicitly requires knowing 2 other jalur documents do NOT mention it, testing negative/exclusion reasoning.

question: Program studi D-III Kesehatan Gigi dan D-III Sanitasi hanya bisa didaftar melalui jalur pendaftaran apa?
expected_answer: Kedua program studi tersebut (D-III Kesehatan Gigi dan D-III Sanitasi) hanya tersedia melalui jalur SPMB Prestasi, tidak tersedia di jalur pendaftaran SPMB lainnya.
notes: Exclusivity fact verified via TERSEDIA_PADA relation aggregation across all 5 jalur (both programs appear only under SPMB Prestasi).

question: Persyaratan dokumen pendaftaran apa yang diwajibkan di SEMUA jalur pendaftaran SPMB Poltekkes Kemenkes Yogyakarta?
expected_answer: KTP, ijazah, dan surat pernyataan/kesanggupan diwajibkan di kelima jalur pendaftaran (Jalur Mandiri, SPMB Bersama, SPMB Mandiri Profesi, SPMB Mandiri Reguler SMA, SPMB Prestasi).
notes: Scoped to KTP/ijazah/surat (standardized document terms, cross-checked consistent across all 5 MENGHARUSKAN relations) -- deliberately excludes buta warna/tinggi badan/sehat jasmani claims, since a real graph-extraction gap was found for those terms (see MH05).

question: Apakah jalur SPMB Mandiri Profesi mensyaratkan tes buta warna bagi pendaftar?
expected_answer: Ya. Berdasarkan dokumen resmi, tahap uji kesehatan SPMB Mandiri Profesi mencakup pemeriksaan fisik yang meliputi tinggi badan, berat badan, tekanan darah, nadi, visus mata, dan butawarna.
notes: DELIBERATE graph-extraction-gap probe: Neo4j's MENGHARUSKAN relation for SPMB Mandiri Profesi does NOT include buta warna/tinggi badan (confirmed via live Cypher query 2026-07-25), but the source PDF explicitly lists them under 'Pemeriksaan fisik' using the concatenated spelling 'butawarna' (no space) rather than 'buta warna' (two words) used elsewhere -- graph_service.py's keyword extraction likely missed this text variant. Correct answer is YES per the source document; this question tests whether Vector RAG (embeddings are more robust to spelling variants) can supply the correct fact even where GraphRAG's extraction has a real gap, or whether the system's actual behavior (with GraphRAG in the loop) gets this wrong.

question: Bandingkan program studi yang tersedia di jalur SPMB Prestasi dengan jalur Jalur Mandiri (RPL) -- program studi apa yang HANYA ada di SPMB Prestasi dan tidak ada di Jalur Mandiri?
expected_answer: D-III Keperawatan, D-III Kesehatan Gigi, dan D-III Sanitasi tersedia di jalur SPMB Prestasi tetapi tidak tersedia di Jalur Mandiri (RPL).
notes: Requires a set-difference comparison across two separately-documented jalur program lists -- the kind of cross-document reasoning literature identifies as GraphRAG's structural strength versus single-chunk vector retrieval.
